entities.summary: Vicente Mut i Armengol was a Mallorcan astronomer, engineer, historian, mathematician and soldier. One of the most distinguished Spanish astronomers of the seventeenth century, Mut studied the Pleiades, the diameter of the Sun, and the determination of the meridians.
